repository.name: nssoc
repository.description: Fault-tolerant neuromorphic SoC in 130 nm on an open PDK, built with open tools. Sources, the 80-document design record, and a preprint about the two levels at which its redundancy claim was false.

release.name: cloud-results-40737889314-1-cdr-v59-tail-loaded-nominal_early
release.body: Exact-source evidence reservation for the current CDR tail RC original ten-case electrical matrix. One source-controlled preparation then nominal early/late, hot early/late, cold early/late, constant zero/one and original clock-stopped/VI-bias-off detection cases. Original numerical, device, phase, clock-to-valid and case gates retained; fresh RC source40576801174; prior failed physical40369539200 and prior eight electrical rejections/two fault detections retained. This is evidence acquisition, not full PHY or production acceptance. Full raw/native evidence stays on GitHub; no automatic native retry.
